The LJ's app, in your hand.

Interactive draft of the iPhone and Android app, on the new opening prices. Food footage and photos are free stock, branded as LJ’s, until our own shoot.

  1. Watch the smash intro, or tap to skip.
  2. Open a burger and make it a meal.
  3. Check out and watch it hit the flat-top.
  4. Flip between the morning and evening looks.
Draft only: no real payment, points or ordering behind it. Stock video and photos from Pexels (free licence). Prices are the proposed opening prices and subject to sign-off. Arabic layout comes with the real build.
